sample_narratives.text:
I am reporting an issue with my bank account at Discover Bank regarding a deposit and transaction history that does not make sense. 

I received a deposit that shows it was made at XXXX AM, but my bank is reflecting a different time ( around XXXX PM ). Additionally, even though the deposit appeared in my account, the funds were not available for me to use. 

I have been using money transferred from my savings account to cover my expenses, which is reflected in my transaction history. This indicates I did not actually receive or use the deposited funds. 

Despite this, the bank is claiming that…

summary: Between 2025-02-03 and 2026-08-03, the CFPB published 2,000 complaints about Discover. Volume is falling (last 3 months averaged 0 per month versus 667 before). The most common issue is "Incorrect information on your report" (23% of complaints), concentrated in credit reporting or other personal consumer reports. The company responded on time to 100% of cases; 89% of closed cases ended without relief. Overall risk signal: Moderate (37/100). This is an exploratory signal from public complaint data, not a regulatory, legal, or investment conclusion.
